facts.fact: The NDPC says the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 and its General Application and Implementation Directive provide the legal framework for protecting personal information.
The Commission, headed by National Commissioner Dr Vincent Olatunji, acts as the supervisory body and receives complaints.
The General Application and Implementation Directive is cited by the NDPC alongside the Act as part of the framework in force.
The NDPC says it has conducted more than 10,000 awareness activities; no decision or sanction is named.
